{{Quote|Supreme Leader, the Corellian Invasion was meticulously planned. I devised tactics to allow us to take the planet with minimal losses. Lightning strikes, perfectly targeted. I acknowledge that your decision to decapitate the enemy's leadership with a single attack was extraordinarily successful. It ended the battle quickly and undoubtedly saved First Order lives and matériel. But it might have gone another way.|Armitage Hux, to Kylo Ren|<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" />}}
The '''conquest of Corellia''', also known as the [[First Order]]'s '''operation on Corellia''', as the '''Corellian invasion''', or as the '''takeover of Corellia''' was as an event during the [[First Order-Resistance War]] that saw the [[planet]] [[Corellia]], home to many [[shipyard]]s and [[Factory|factories]], fall to the First Order. The regime began an [[Occupation of Corellia|occupation]] that most [[Corellian]]s quickly accepted.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I would submit that there might be other targets where our military resources could be better allocated. For instance, we still remain without a suitable shipyard after the losses at Starkiller Base and Crait.|Armitage Hux, to Kylo Ren|<ref name="Legacy of Vader 5">[[Legacy of Vader 5|''Legacy of Vader'' 5]]</ref>}}
Despite the [[First Order]] still having many [[legion]]s<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> and [[battalion]]s across the galaxy, they still lost many ships following the [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destruction]] of [[Starkiller Base]] and the [[Battle of Crait]], which cost them the [[Supremacy]] and a large portion of their fleet. During [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]'s personal travels to [[Mustafar]] and [[Tatooine]], [[General]] [[Armitage Hux|Hux]] began devising a battle plan to conquer [[Corellia]] in an attempt to give the First Order a new shipyard.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 1">[[Legacy of Vader 1|''Legacy of Vader'' 1]]</ref><ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> 

After Ren ordered to [[Assault on Naboo (First Order)|invade]] [[Naboo]] as part of his own personal quest to learn where [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]'s true power lied, General Hux questioned the Supreme Leader and wondered why didn't they try to invade Corellia instead, but he was only met with a reprimand of his superior. In the middle of one of their battles to fully take over Naboo, Hux was giving orders to fire one of their autocannons to destroy the Naboo forces until him and the rest of the First Order were ordered to withdraw from the fight by Kylo Ren, with the First Order retreating and leaving Naboo free.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 5" />

==The conquest==
{{Quote|This is Supreme Leader Kylo Ren. All First Order fighters, form up on me, keep the enemy off my flanks. I'm going for the command center.|Kylo Ren, to the First Order|<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" />}}
Following their retreat from [[Naboo]], the [[First Order]] began their invasion of [[Corellia]] using [[General]] [[Armitage Hux|Hux]]'s battle plan, which consisted of a siege anchored by their strongest units in an attempt to take over the planet with minimal losses. With the General leading the invasion, the First Order used their ships and [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[battalion]]s to overwhelm the [[Corellian]] forces. As the Corellian fighters fell, [[Commander]] [[Grayton]] commented that due to Hux's battle plan they would secure Corellia and its shipyards with negligible casualties on their end. General Hux thanked the Commander but was quick to point out that all of the battle's participants were heroes of the First Order.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> 

[[File:RenAgainstCorellianForces-LegacyOfVader6.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Supreme Leader Kylo Ren taking down Corellian starfighters during the invasion.]]
Suddenly, [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] joined the battle with his [[Kylo Ren's TIE silencer|TIE silencer]] and quickly dispatched the Corellian forces out of the sky. The Supreme Leader ordered his fighters to form around him to keep the Corellian forces off his flanks as he headed directly towards the command center headquarters in an attempt to take out the planet's leadership in one strike. Taken by surprise by the Supreme Leader's sudden arrival to take on the most heavily defended spot on the planet, General Hux told Commander Grayton that they should abide by Ren's orders and pray for his safety. Despite being hit during his attack run, the Supreme Leader successfully destroyed the command center headquarters. This decisive attack prompted the Corellian leaders to surrender, with the First Order taking over their shipyards in order to replace the assets lost during previous battles.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The invasion was a success on all levels. The planet's leadership surrendered when it became clear they could not continue to resist. We control Corellia's shipyards and factories, and can begin replacing assets lost at Starkiller Base, Crait, Naboo and so on. Small pockets of insurgency remain, but we will stamp them out.|Armitage Hux, to Kylo Ren|<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" />}}
[[File:FirstOrderCelebratesKyloRen-LegacyOfVader6.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Following their first major victory, the First Order celebrated their Supreme Leader for his decisive actions during the invasion.]]
Immediately following the battle, stormtroopers and officers aboard<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> the First Order [[flagship]]<ref name="Legacy of Vader 8">[[Legacy of Vader 8|''Legacy of Vader'' 8]]</ref> ''[[Finalizer]]'' chanted and celebrated Ren—who sat upon a [[Kylo Ren's throne|new throne]]<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> built of rare materials<ref name="Legacy of Vader 4">[[Legacy of Vader 4|''Legacy of Vader'' 4]]</ref> and designed by Hux on Ren's order—for his efforts during the invasion while Hux stood by his side, something that Ren knew upset Hux. Ren ordered to see Hux in his chambers for an after-action report, but the angered general followed said report by mentioning that he would have preferred to be informed about any actions similar to those the Supreme Leader took during the invasion, as being told would have ensured he did not have to react to surprises from both sides of the conflict. Ren ordered Hux to dismiss himself instead, not wanting to be chastised by his inferior, before [[Mission to Lahtee|departing]] for the planet [[Lahtee]], looking for a surviving [[Jedi]]<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" />—the [[Theelin]] [[Grandea]]<ref name="Legacy of Vader 7">[[Legacy of Vader 7|''Legacy of Vader'' 7]]</ref>—whom his servant, [[Vaneé]], had located after advising Ren to find a real challenge<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> via a worthy opponent.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 7" />

The takeover of Corellia represented the first major victory of the First Order following their heavy losses on [[Crait]] and [[Naboo]]. Having successfully taken over the planet's shipyards and factories,<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> the First Order began its [[occupation of Corellia]]. While most [[Corellian]]s were scornful of being subjects to the occupation,<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> which included the creation of some small insurgency groups,<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> most Corellians<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> quickly<ref name="DateNote">''[[Resistance Reborn]]'' is set after the [[First Order]] has [[Conquest of Corellia|taken control]] of [[Corellia]], which is depicted in [[Legacy of Vader 6|''Legacy of Vader'' 6]]. Therefore, ''Legacy of Vader'' 6 must be set before ''Resistance Reborn''. Furthermore, ''Legacy of Vader'' 6 is set after [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. ''Resistance Reborn'' says that most [[Corellian]]s "eventually" accepted the occupation. As there is only a short [[time]] between ''The Last Jedi'' and ''Resistance Reborn'' according to the latter's narrative, with an even shorter time therefore occurring between ''Legacy of Vader'' and its events, this "eventually" time frame must have been quick.</ref> accepted the new reality.<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> Among the insurgent cells that resisted the occupation<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" /> was the [[Collective]], a grouping of technology-focused individuals who opposed the expansion of authoritarianism. Resistance agents carried out a [[mission to Corellia]]<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> a short time later<ref name="DateNote" /> in order to recover a First Order list of targets being auctioned by the Collective and to steal starships for their cause.<ref name="Resistance Reborn" />

While Ren was busy with his business on Lahtee,<ref name="Legacy of Vader 7" /> the First Order gained complete control over the Corellian facilities in short order. Those shipyards were already ready to produce starfighters for the First Order fleet by the time Hux reported their progress to Ren aboard the ''Finalizer'', although minor issues seen throughout the fabrication plants prevented a possible delay in the construction of [[capital ship]]s. As Hux informed Ren of the update from Corellia, their conversation was interrupted by the arrival of the [[Knights of Ren]], the Supreme Leader's former followers<ref name="Legacy of Vader 8" /> who would submit back to his command.<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The conquest of Corellia was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in the novel ''[[Resistance Reborn]]''<ref name="Resistance Reborn" /> before being identified as the "takeover of Corellia" in the solicit for [[Legacy of Vader 6|''Legacy of Vader'' 6]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/star-wars-the-high-republic-the-finale-and-more-revealed-star-wars-celebration-japan|text='Star Wars: The High Republic - The Finale' and More Marvel 'Star Wars' Titles Revealed At Star Wars Celebration}}</ref> The issue itself would depict the event and give it several names beyond the "conquest of Corellia" title, dubbing it both the "operation on Corellia" and "Corellian invasion" as well.<ref name="Legacy of Vader 6" />
